## D&D 5e Icon Set

The condition, concentration, cold-damage, and walking icons in this directory
are from [Intrinsical's D&D 5e Icon Set](https://github.com/intrinsical/tw-dnd/tree/main/icons)
by David Kor Kian Wei.
